---
title: "Sprott G System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& ax-z \\
\dot{y} &=& xz-y\\
\dot{z} &=& x+y
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.4$ and initial condition $(-1,0,2)$.
